title: Splitting a work order moves a line that holds an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPLIT-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open with two approved lines: {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT line") holds no parts and {Line-2} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT line 2") holds {Part-A}, added while it was active.
  • The split makes a new work order, {Work-order-2} (for example S2-15441).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and tick the checkbox of {Line-2}.
  2. Open the bulk-action menu, click "Split work order" and confirm.
  3. Open the new work order {Work-order-2}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The split completes without an inactive-part refusal.
  • Step 3: {Work-order-2} holds {Line-2} with {Part-A}; {Work-order-1} keeps {Line-1} only.
